title: All-in-One Multi-Industry Edition • 60-FPS Motion-Video Festival Top Animation Update
highlights: 60-FPS Motion-Video Style Festival & Birthday Top Strip: Articulated galloping reindeer & Santa sleigh over snowy mountains (Christmas), shooting skyrockets & flower-pot fountains with glowing terracotta Diyas (Deepavali), steaming overflowing Pongal pots on firewood & walking Kangayam bullocks with farmer ploughing (Pongal), and 3D glossy balloons with swirling metallic confetti (Owner Birthday).

Plan-Specific VIP License Activation Celebration: Animated Golden Confetti, Sparkles & VIP Certificate strictly for the customer's activated plan tier (1 Year, 3 Years Offer, or Lifetime + Android App).
First-Install Shop Owner Birthday Collection: Collects Shop Owner Date of Birth during First-Install Setup & Company Settings for automatic Birthday Wishes on the actual day (no previews).
Customer Birthday Reminder & 1-Click WhatsApp Wish: Send personalized Birthday Wishes directly to customers from the Dashboard.
3-Tier Subscription Plans: 1 Year (₹1,500), 3 Years Offer (₹3,000), and Lifetime + Android App Combo (₹9,000).
fixes: Replaced flat emoji symbols in the top animation strip with articulated 60-FPS custom vector motion-graphics scenes.
Prevented Free Plan monthly quota reset when deleting Invoices, Quotations, Job Sheets, or Products.
Optimized Windows Defender & SmartScreen compliance with signed installer and non-solid compression.
